_comment: Natural submit rules shared by the Mac (MightyCore), Windows Core, the Windows page (vitest) and the phone (jest); docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-27-natural-submit-design.md, docs/interaction.md. Times are in ms; the rule's numbers are design-tokens.json motion.pendingShowAfter (150) and motion.pendingMinVisible (300), and scripts/check-design-tokens.js checks every display case against them.
displayRule: Visible once pending has lasted pendingShowAfter (now >= startedAt + showAfter). A pending that ended by then (endedAt <= startedAt + showAfter) is never shown. Once shown it stays while pending and at least until startedAt + showAfter + minVisible (inclusive), then hides at once: visible while now < endedAt or now <= startedAt + showAfter + minVisible. `failed: true` (absent means false) is visible from endedAt (the failure) on, at once, and stays. Reduce Motion changes no timing, only the movement.

display.name: still pending at 0 ms: not shown
still pending at 149 ms: not shown yet
still pending at 150 ms: shown from here
still pending at 2 s: shown
start time is not 0: 149 ms after it, not shown
start time is not 0: 150 ms after it, shown
ended at 100 ms, now 100 ms: never shown
ended at 100 ms, now 150 ms: never shown
ended at 100 ms, now 300 ms: never shown
ended right at 150 ms: never shown
ended right at 150 ms, now 300 ms: never shown
ended at 200 ms, now 199 ms: shown, still pending
ended at 200 ms, now 200 ms: kept, shown for 50 ms only
ended at 200 ms, now 450 ms: kept until 150 + 300
ended at 200 ms, now 451 ms: hidden
ended at 460 ms, now 455 ms: shown, still pending
ended at 460 ms, now 460 ms: hidden at once, shown for more than 300 ms
ended at 900 ms, now 899 ms: shown
ended at 900 ms, now 900 ms: hidden at once, shown for more than 300 ms
start time is not 0: ended 200 ms after it, kept until 450 ms after it
start time is not 0: ended 200 ms after it, hidden 451 ms after it
failed at 40 ms: shown at once
failed at 40 ms, now 5 s: the error stays

submitRule: outcome: the body's `outcome` when it is started, queued or steered; else its `accepted` when that is one of those words (old hosts); else null. accepted: outcome is not null. entryId, runId: the body's value when it is a non-empty string, else null. Other fields (protocol, draft, state) are ignored. New hosts keep sending `accepted` as the outcome word so older phones still read it.

submitResponses.name: older host: steered into the running turn
new host: started with its entry and run
new host: queued, no block yet so no ids
new host: steered into the running run
accepted as a boolean with an outcome
outcome wins over the accepted word
Windows page send bridge: no request was made
ids that are not non-empty strings are dropped
an unknown word is not accepted
an empty body is not accepted

scrollRule: own (this composer's Enter, a queued request that now runs, 다음 실행, a selected ⌘Enter child): scroll toRequest in every view whatever the position, with resetBoard when the 파이프라인 shows an older board. Not own: today's follow rule, follow when nearBottom (at the newest end, or the follow camera is on) else none; on an older 파이프라인 board always none (the badge says there is more). resetBoard is only ever true for own submits. chosenBoard is newest outside the 파이프라인.

scrollTargets.name: pipeline, own, an older board is chosen: back to the newest
pipeline, own, an older board scrolled to its end
basic, not own, at the bottom: follow
basic, not own, reading above: stay
diagram, not own, camera elsewhere: stay
timeline, not own, at the end: follow
timeline, not own, reading above: stay
pipeline, not own, newest board at its end: follow
pipeline, not own, older board: stay, the badge says there is more
pipeline, not own, older board, not at its end: stay
